description: Read ONE Cite Q&A by exact answer slug: question, answer_sentence, metric, EAN, ranked shop offers[], buy_url. Works even when live offers are empty (found=false) — unlike get_unit_price, which errors without offers. Use AFTER search_cite_answers when you need the Cite body / full offer table / citation text. Do NOT use for a short €/unit commerce quote only — prefer get_unit_price. Do NOT use for PNG — use get_price_card. Do NOT use to compare 2+ products — use compare_unit_prices. Requires exact slug. Read-only, idempotent. Brand: nakus.sk ≠ nakup.sk.
